reviewScope: Direct visual inspection of selected actual Unity Game View PNGs from the completed final capture; automated matrix and runtime receipts cover the remaining capture cases.
observations: The arrival shows the correct Great Kushville city header and the existing authored menu placement with the city palette.
The community building is fully framed in both pre-project and growing captures. The three completed community buildings, including the tall founders arch, fit inside the HUD-free viewport.
The earlier diagnostic roof cropping was resolved by an evidence-camera framing change that considers the active renderer bounds. Production scene camera settings were not changed for this repair.
The water laboratory and canal workshop are visibly distinct, with transparent sprite edges and consistent ground placement; both remain visible alongside the completed community hall.
The offline continuation preserves the workshop and completed community hall. The return capture shows Burning Hills with its existing art and city header.
The sampled initial quest, resident detail and German choice screen are readable with complete action buttons in the smallest landscape resolution.

The Russian portrait choice screen keeps its title, goals and both choices visible. Its longer narrative uses the existing masked scrolling detail area; the screenshot is a viewport sample, not a claim that all scrollable prose is visible at once.
The final Great Kushville travel row and current-city state are fully visible in ultrawide Spanish and portrait Russian samples. Previous rows are cropped only by the intended travel scroll viewport.
No blocking visual issue was observed in these inspected samples. Technical capture evidence does not constitute personal art approval or a physical-device acceptance test.
